source: passive TShark capture of USBPcap1 and USBPcap2, filtered to bus 2 device address 3
scope: Read-only passive capture; selected controller traffic only. No device commands or movement were sent.
findings: AF 45 00 was followed by a 28-byte reply beginning 45 01 02 03; 23 query/reply cycles were observed at roughly 1.3-second intervals.
AF 45 reply payloads differed only at zero-based byte offset 17: 0xE4 in 21 replies and 0xE1 in 2 replies; remaining bytes were identical.
AF 53 was followed by a constant 14-byte reply beginning 53 42 03 01; 23 query/reply cycles were observed.
The small AF 45 variation is a candidate changing field, but no resistance value was deliberately varied or timestamp-correlated to the application display. Its meaning and units remain unverified.
No motor target or drill write was captured.
limitations: The capture was passive and did not manipulate the resistance sensor or its contact.
No mapping from AF 45 byte offset 17 to displayed resistance, units, sign, scale or calibration is established.
Controller telemetry does not independently verify physical resistance or contact.
